candidates.change_summary: Remove the statement that adds msg.value to balances[msg.sender], so deposits never update the balance.
Replace the accumulation `balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value;` with an assignment `balances[msg.sender]=msg.value;`, overwriting any prior balance instead of adding to it.
Change the deposit guard from '>=' to '>' so a deposit of exactly MinDeposit is rejected.
Delete the statement that adds the deposited value to the caller's balance.
Replace the balance accumulation with an assignment that overwrites the balance with only the deposited value.
Delete the statement that decrements the caller's balance, so balances[msg.sender] is never reduced after CashOut.
Move the balance-decrement statement after the external call, reintroducing a reentrancy window where the caller's balance is still un-deducted during the callback.
Change the guard from <= to <, so withdrawing exactly the full balance reverts and the balance remains unchanged.
